title: Shared session encoder + T1 head, tuned on the frozen v1 data
merge_reason: S2-SMOKE already delivered a small training smoke; repeating it produces nothing new

scope.data: frozen v1 artifacts, not rebuilt and not extended

batch_spec.note: FROZEN at the end of this task. Renaming a channel or resizing a vocabulary forces S2-SE-01 to re-export and S2-SE-02 to re-benchmark.

history_categorical.name: product_bucket
history_categorical.meaning: blake2b hash of the raw product id, 1..49999, 0 PAD

history_categorical.name: brand_bucket
history_categorical.meaning: blake2b hash of the brand string, 1..4999, 0 PAD

history_categorical.name: price_band
history_categorical.meaning: 0..4 exactly as frozen in price_transform_v1, 5 PAD

batch_spec.query_note: the canonical validator forbids a pad id anywhere in a query channel, so for a T1-only row the query is the decision's own item, which always exists

model.encoder_note: the architecture is deliberately NOT frozen here; S2-DS-05 may replace it behind this interface
model.readout: full padded sequence then gather at clamp(lengths-1, min=0)
model.readout_reason: pack_padded_sequence obstructs the ONNX export S2-SE-01 needs; with right-padding the two are mathematically identical and a fixture asserts they agree to 1e-5
model.output_names_note: FROZEN. S2-SE-08 verifies these by name.

training.selection: lowest validation loss, strict <, never the last epoch
training.loop: our own; LocalTrainerCore packs and sha256-hashes the whole state_dict every step, which is unusable at 6081 steps per epoch

seeds.reason: S2-PR-09 runs the final R1 across these three, and S2-PR-06 must start R2a from the identical common initialization
seeds.common_initialization: emitted per seed with its sha256 so R1 and R2a provably start from the same weights

calibration.target_meaning: S2-SMOKE, GRU category-only, category-change slice, macro
calibration.tolerance: MEASURED, not assumed: the replica runs on all three seeds and the gate is that 0.3348 falls inside the observed seed range
calibration.gate: hard - if it fails the pipeline is wrong and no number above it means anything

ladder.question: does product identity pay at 2.6x the data?
ladder.prediction: positive; it scored -0.0031 at 1.2M while overfitting from epoch 2

ladder.question: is the board's two-layer ask justified?
how far do hyperparameters move it?

sweep.kind: coordinate, one axis at a time from the rung-5 winner, not a full grid
sweep.report: every configuration tried is recorded, not only the winner

handoff_bar.if_not_met: hand over anyway with the shortfall stated plainly; the federated comparison still needs a model
